examples.text: Because the conference room is filled, we will have our meeting in the adjacent room.

glosses: Just before, after, or facing.

examples.text: The picture is on the adjacent page.

glosses: Related to; suggestive of; bordering on.

examples.text: It would be false to suggest CBD is nothing more than an obsession for reiki-adjacent bicoastal millennials.

glosses: Something that lies next to something else, especially the side of a right triangle that is neither the hypotenuse nor the opposite.
